Hello everyone,

This week's AI Brain Trust Weekly  is now out. The Intelligence Layer Meets the Real World

AI is entering a new phase. Intelligence is moving beyond models and chat interfaces into software development, scientific research, enterprise workflows, infrastructure, and the physical world.

In this week's, we examine the signals showing that the next AI battleground is no longer simply model capability.
It is the infrastructure and control layer surrounding intelligence.

This week's edition covers:
1. Anthropic's Model Hardware Standard and the move toward AI-controlled physical systems
2. OpenAI's Hugging Face incident and the emerging challenge of AI agent containment
3. Ramp
